title: Crop Candidate and Event Delivery Atomicity Frontier

source_bound_findings.finding: F-WOF33 completes the two-phase crop window into a wofost_crop_owner_state_t candidate and does not publish committed crop state itself.
F-KT candidate provenance and physical state are private. Callers can inspect snapshots and origin metadata but cannot forge lineage/revision publication authority.

In the inspected current F-KT contract, kernel_advance_interval materializes kernel_candidate_state_t from a bound kernel_model_t and stamps lineage, revision and t0/t1 provenance; kernel_commit_candidate is the publication route and rejects invalid, stale, lineage-mismatched or time-mismatched candidates.

F-WOF34 prepare_wofost_crop_event_delivery is read-only and returns frozen aggregates plus a provenance token; commit_wofost_crop_event_delivery only sets accepted-window event_delivered after token validation and does not publish wofost_crop_owner_state_t.

The inspected current src/kernel directory contains only mod_kernel_transactions.f90. The inspected current src/runtime listing contains the WOFOST accepted-window lineage and physical-trial binding modules but no separately named WOFOST crop-candidate transaction adapter or WOFOST kernel model.
source_bound_findings.scope: This is a statement about the inspected F-WOF37 tree, not a universal claim about all branches or future code.

source_bound_findings.finding: Repository code search for extends(kernel_model_t) returned no match in the searchable repository view used during this workunit. This supports but does not independently prove absence on every historical branch.

atomicity_hazard.unsafe_sequence_A: commit_wofost_crop_event_delivery first, then attempt crop-owner publication
atomicity_hazard.failure_A: the accepted window can become event_delivered while the crop owner remains at the old state if crop publication fails or is unavailable
atomicity_hazard.unsafe_sequence_B: publish wofost_crop_owner_state_t outside F-KT, then mark event delivered
atomicity_hazard.failure_B: this bypasses the current F-KT provenance/commit contract and still leaves a split-state failure boundary between owner publication and delivery marking
atomicity_hazard.unsafe_sequence_C: fabricate or expose a generic external kernel_candidate_state_t adoption helper solely for WOFOST
atomicity_hazard.failure_C: this would weaken the deliberately opaque provenance boundary and create a generic bypass around kernel_advance_interval rather than solving composition ownership

required_property: Crop-owner publication and exactly-once crop-event delivery acknowledgment must have one qualified transactional outcome. A failed or discarded attempt must leave both the committed crop owner and delivery state unchanged; an accepted retry must publish both once from the same accepted-window provenance.

architecture_assessment.invariant_7_transactional_timesteps: BLOCKED_FOR_END_TO_END_CROP_EVENT_COMMIT until owner publication and delivery acknowledgment are composed transactionally
architecture_assessment.invariant_8_cheap_recompute: requires rejected/failed crop-event completion to remain replayable from the same committed crop owner and frozen accepted aggregates
architecture_assessment.invariant_13_mass_conservation: not directly changed by the crop structural candidate, but physical PTRA/QROT evidence must remain bound to the accepted physical trajectory and must not be redelivered
architecture_assessment.invariant_16_multiswap: future commit seam must be column-local and sparse, without a heavyweight transaction owner per inactive column
architecture_assessment.invariant_28_runtime_coupler_composition: PASS_DIRECTIONALLY: the missing composition belongs in runtime/transaction ownership, not inside the crop kernel
architecture_assessment.invariant_30_qualification: PASS_FAIL_CLOSED: no production end-to-end admission is claimed while the atomic seam is absent

preferred_next_design_space: A component-aware/composite transaction participant that owns crop-owner candidate publication and delivery acknowledgment under one accepted transaction outcome.

A WOFOST-specific kernel_model_t / transaction adapter is acceptable only if it genuinely preserves F-KT provenance and also resolves delivery acknowledgment atomicity; a model adapter alone is insufficient if event_delivered remains a second independently committed owner.

A design where delivery status is derived from the committed crop transaction revision/event identity may reduce the dual-owner problem, but changing F-WOF34 semantics would require a separate source-bound qualification.
explicit_non_solution: Do not add a generic arbitrary external-candidate adoption API merely to inject wofost_crop_owner_state_t into kernel_candidate_state_t.
allowed_F_WOF37_followup: Qualification-only composition may proceed through begin crop window -> accepted physical PTRA/QROT -> frozen delivery prepare -> complete WOFOST crop candidate. It must stop before production publication and must prove that failure/retry leaves delivery uncommitted and the original crop owner unchanged.
